messages:
auto-incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Helios Analytics (tenant: helios-prod) — eu-west-1 dedicated pool 'helios-pool-1' p99 latency spike detected. p95=1.9s (SLO 0.6s), p99=6.8s (SLO 1.2s). Error rate stable. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/helios/latency - paging on-call.

maria (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Paging SRE and runtime.

jamal (sre): I'm up. grabbing traces now. Any customer impact reported by support?

sophie (acct): Support hasn't reported inbound yet but customer console shows elevated error/latency alerts — I can ping the customer if this looks like a real SLO breach.

lee (eng-runtime): on standby. initial guess: KV cache pressure + occasional tokenization overhead from the new quantized model variant. Will check kernel selection logs.

maria (oncall): Quick triage: traffic is normal, but a single tenant (helios-prod) shows huge tail. CPU/GPU utilization on the pool looks fine but queue length for serve workers is spiking. Screens: `kubectl top pods -n helios-prod` shows pods with long CPU sys times.

jamal (sre): Captured traces for samples. p99 requests waiting on 'kv_fetch' step and then long mutex wait on batch-allocator. Copying snippet: ```trace snippet
request_id=abcd1234 step=kv_fetch duration=4200ms
request_id=efgh5678 step=batch_alloc wait=2100ms
```

triage-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1090 Helios eu-west dedicated p99 breach. Severity: Sev2. Runbook: dedicated-pool-high-latency. Oncall: maria.

maria (oncall): Mitigation options I propose (ranked): 1) Move helios tenant to warm spare dedicated pool (manual migration) — fastest. 2) Enable per-tenant rate limiting / reject-heavy requests — lowers load but impacts throughput. 3) Rollback to non-quantized model variant for helios — avoid new code path. Which do we prefer?

devon (infra): We have a warm spare pool in eu-west tagged 'spare-eu-2' with capacity for +20% throughput. I can trigger tenant migration: command is `./admin move-tenant --tenant helios-prod --from helios-pool-1 --to spare-eu-2`. It takes ~40-120s to drain and reattach.

lee (eng-runtime): Before moving, can we try immediate kernel fallback? There's a config `runtime.override_kernel=stable_v3` that avoids the new kernel's batch mutex path. That would be a config flip at the pool-level, quick to rollback if wrong. Risk: small perf hit but may reduce tail.

jamal (sre): I'd prefer move-first if spare pool is ready. If migration fails or doesn't help, flip kernel. We want minimum customer disruption.

maria (oncall): Agreed. Devon, start the migration. Jamal, watch traces. Lee, standby to toggle kernel if migration doesn't reduce p99 in 3 min. Sophie, draft a 1-line notify for Helios: "We're investigating a latency spike affecting your EU workload; mitigation in progress, will update in 15 mins."

devon (infra): Running move now: ```bash
./admin move-tenant --tenant helios-prod --from helios-pool-1 --to spare-eu-2 --drain-timeout 120
```

devon (infra): Move started — tasks: draining 8 worker pods, reattaching network routes. ETA 90s.

jamal (sre): Watching traces. After migration start, p99 dropped from 6.8s -> 3.1s within 45s. Queue length reducing. Good sign.

maria (oncall): :eyes: Keep monitoring. If p99 > 2.0s after 3m we flip kernel.

lee (eng-runtime): Ready to run kernel flip. Command: `rbctl pools patch helios-pool-1 --set runtime.override_kernel=stable_v3` — can do rollback immediately.

devon (infra): Move completed. All traffic on helios-prod now on spare-eu-2. Health checks green.

jamal (sre): Metrics update: p95=0.7s, p99=1.25s. Still slightly above p99 SLO but within reasonable. Error rate unchanged. Looks like noisy neighbor isolation helped.

maria (oncall): Sophie — please send the customer this update (short): "We've isolated the latency spike to your dedicated pool and migrated your traffic to a spare pool. We're continuing to monitor — p99 has improved but we will follow up with a root cause and timeline. Apologies for the disruption."

sophie (acct): Posting to Helios now. Sent via email + support console. Will paste thread link in reply.

rajesh (devex): Noted for follow-up: the tenant was on quantized model v1.4.6b which we onboarded last week. Could be a model-runtime interaction with batching. I'll capture evals and add to RCA.

lee (eng-runtime): I pulled kernel logs from helios-pool-1 — seeing frequent batch_alloc mutex contention on the quantized path. Opening ticket ENG-RUNTIME-1329. Suggest we schedule a rollback of quantized variant for helios until patch.

jamal (sre): For now set a temporary per-tenant reject policy at 10k qps to avoid recurrence while we patch. Command: `rbctl tenants update helios-prod --rate-limit 10000`

maria (oncall): Done. Applied per-tenant limit. Monitoring shows stable tails. We'll keep spare pool assignment for 3 hours to be safe.

devon (infra): Noted: spare-eu-2 has slightly higher cost — finance heads up for chargeback.

maria (oncall): Summary for incident record: - Impact: Helios-prod p99 spike to 6.8s, customer-facing alerts. - Mitigation: migrated tenant to spare-eu-2, applied per-tenant rate limit. - Current status: p95 0.65s, p99 1.18s (within SLO target). - Next steps: eng-runtime to patch kernel/quantized path (ENG-RUNTIME-1329), schedule postmortem and tenant rollback test.

triage-bot: Incident severity downgraded to Sev3. Postmortem scheduled: 2123457800. Owner: jamal (sre).

maria (oncall): Handing off to jamal for follow-up and postmortem. I'm stepping off on-call in 15m.

jamal (sre): Taking post-incident owner. I'll coordinate with lee and rajesh, and keep Sophie looped for customer comms. Closing live war room. :thumbsup:

sophie (acct): Customer acknowledged and appreciated quick migration. Asked for ETA on permanent fix. I've scheduled a customer call after the postmortem.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving notes in the incident ticket.

lee (eng-runtime): I'll triage kernel patch this sprint and try a backport for quantized branch.

rajesh (devex): I'll add a regression eval comparing quantized v1.4.6b vs v1.4.5 across typical Helios prompt sets.

jamal (sre): Final metrics snapshot attached to ticket: p95_history=[0.5,0.6,0.7], p99_history=[0.9,1.2,1.18]. Marking mitigation successful.

triage-bot: War room closed. Incident file: /incidents/INC-2026-1090/2123456789-helios-warm-spare-migration.json

maria (oncall): :white_check_mark:
